title: Chummer6 Product Threads 90s MagicFit Promo
source_claim: 11 MagicFit-rendered product-thread scene clips rebuilt with cleaner spoken narration and simplified Horizon taxonomy

scene_narration.caption: The table is alive. Chummer6 keeps the work in one place.
scene_narration.narration: The table is alive, but the tools are fighting it. Chummer6 brings the runner, the rules, and the campaign back into one product spine.

scene_narration.caption: NEXUS-PAN is continuity and recovery for devices at the table.
scene_narration.narration: NEXUS-PAN belongs in the product story: shared state, reconnects, and recovery when the campaign spans devices.

scene_narration.caption: ALICE is a base workbench feature for build help and rules explanation.
scene_narration.narration: ALICE belongs in the product itself. It compares builds, catches role traps, and explains tradeoffs before play starts.

scene_narration.caption: KARMA FORGE is the expansion bet for governed rule evolution.
scene_narration.narration: KARMA FORGE stays on the expansion shelf: house rules with impact, history, review, and rollback instead of chat-log folklore.

scene_narration.caption: JACKPOINT joins the campaign-memory lane.
scene_narration.narration: JACKPOINT is easier to understand as campaign memory: briefings, dossiers, and recaps players actually want to read.

scene_narration.caption: RUNSITE is a specialized play mode for readable mission spaces.
scene_narration.narration: RUNSITE is a specialized play mode. It makes mission spaces legible before the action starts without becoming the whole product.

scene_narration.caption: RUNBOOK PRESS joins the publish/share lane.
scene_narration.narration: RUNBOOK PRESS belongs with publishing: primers, guides, modules, and season books the table can carry forward.

scene_narration.caption: TABLE PULSE is campaign operations, not a random extra brand.
scene_narration.narration: TABLE PULSE is the campaign layer: live heat, bounded reactions, remote choices, and GM-approved fallout.

scene_narration.caption: BLACK LEDGER remains the big living-city expansion bet.
scene_narration.narration: BLACK LEDGER stays the big campaign expansion bet: factions, heat, missions, newsreels, and consequences the city remembers.

scene_narration.caption: COMMUNITY HUB joins the social and open-run lane.
scene_narration.narration: COMMUNITY HUB is the social lane: open runs, preflight, scheduling, and outcomes that feed back into Chummer truth.

scene_narration.caption: One product spine: build, explain, run, remember, publish.
scene_narration.narration: One product spine: build the runner, explain the choices, run the table, remember the consequences, and publish only what the table approves.

proof_constraints: Core product areas and expansion bets are separated in captions, narration, and receipt.
The public asset uses existing MagicFit-rendered source clips rebuilt with new narration and captions.
The receipt must not claim all listed surfaces are current shipped features.
